title: Kenya Riverine Flood Hotspots & Fluvial Inundation Corridors
description: Authoritative spatial inventory of major Kenya riverine flood hotspots, floodplain overtopping reaches, and critical infrastructure severance corridors (KE-58). Synthesized from JRC GloFAS RP20 return periods, Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR flood observations, Kenya Food Security Steering Group (KFSSG) assessments, National Drought Management Authority (NDMA) early warning bulletins, and Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) advisories.
attribution: Adaptation Atlas Kenya / KFSSG / NDMA / KMD / OpenStreetMap contributors
